description.value: A drive-through McDonald's on Russ Baker Way in Richmond, conveniently located near Vancouver International Airport and the cycling routes along the Fraser River delta. The location is wheelchair accessible and offers the full Canadian McDonald's menu including breakfast, burgers, McCafé beverages, and desserts. For touring cyclists passing through Richmond, it provides a reliable, quick-service food stop with indoor seating and free Wi-Fi.
